an11.21:1.1: tatra kho āyasmā sāriputto bhikkhū āmantesi
an11.21:1.2: siyā nu kho āvuso bhikkhuno tathārūpo samādhipaṭilābho yathā neva paṭhaviyaṃ paṭhavīsaññī assa na āpasmiṃ āposaññī assa na tejasmiṃ tejosaññī assa na vāyasmiṃ vāyosaññī assa na ākāsānañcāyatane ākāsānañcāyatanasaññī assa na viññāṇañcāyatane viññāṇañcāyatanasaññī assa na ākiñcaññāyatane ākiñcaññāyatanasaññī assa na nevasaññānāsaññāyatane nevasaññānāsaññāyatanasaññī assa na idhaloke idhalokasaññī assa na paraloke paralokasaññī assa yamidaṃ diṭṭhaṃ sutaṃ mutaṃ viññātaṃ pattaṃ pariyesitaṃ anuvicaritaṃ manasā tatrāpi na saññī assa saññī ca pana assāti.
an11.21:2.1: dūratopi kho mayaṃ āvuso āgaccheyyāma āyasmato sāriputtassa santike etassa bhāsitassa atthamaññātuṃ
an11.21:2.2: sādhu vatāyasmantaṃyeva sāriputtaṃ paṭibhātu etassa bhāsitassa attho
an11.21:3.1: tenahāvuso taṃ suṇātha sādhukaṃ manasikarotha bhāsissāmīti.
an11.21:3.2: evamāvusoti kho te bhikkhū āyasmato sāriputtassa paccassosuṃ.
an11.21:4.1: siyā āvuso bhikkhuno tathārūpo samādhipaṭilābho yathā neva paṭhaviyaṃ paṭhavīsaññī assa …pe… yamidaṃ diṭṭhaṃ sutaṃ mutaṃ viññātaṃ pattaṃ pariyesitaṃ anuvicaritaṃ manasā tatrāpi na saññī assa saññī ca pana assāti.
an11.21:5.1: yathākathaṃ panāvuso sāriputta siyā bhikkhuno tathārūpo samādhipaṭilābho yathā neva paṭhaviyaṃ paṭhavīsaññī assa …pe… yamidaṃ diṭṭhaṃ sutaṃ mutaṃ viññātaṃ pattaṃ pariyesitaṃ anuvicaritaṃ manasā tatrāpi na saññī assa saññī ca pana assāti.
an11.21:6.2: etaṃ santaṃ etaṃ paṇītaṃ yadidaṃ sabbasaṃkhārasamatho sabbūpadhipaṭinissaggo taṇhakkhayo virāgo nirodho nibbānanti
an11.21:6.3: evampi kho āvuso siyā bhikkhuno tathārūpo samādhipaṭilābho yathā neva paṭhaviyaṃ paṭhavīsaññī assa na āpasmiṃ āposaññī assa na tejasmiṃ tejosaññī assa na vāyasmiṃ vāyosaññī assa na ākāsānañcāyatane ākāsānañcāyatanasaññī assa na viññāṇañcāyatane viññāṇañcāyatanasaññī assa na ākiñcaññāyatane ākiñcaññāyatanasaññī assa na nevasaññānāsaññāyatane nevasaññānāsaññāyatanasaññī assa na idhaloke idhalokasaññī assa na paraloke paralokasaññī assa yamidaṃ diṭṭhaṃ sutaṃ mutaṃ viññātaṃ pattaṃ pariyesitaṃ anuvicaritaṃ manasā tatrāpi na saññī assa saññī ca pana assāti.
